purpose: Reproduce and classify only the two frozen Step 4A feature-integrity failures without modifying the feature pipeline or reporting market values.

bad_ts_recv_diagnostic.scope: Every MBO and MBP-10 row with flags bit 8 set, plus all snapshot rows for bidirectional coverage reporting.
tests_per_bad_flag_row: ts_recv is inside the frozen request interval
ts_event is strictly before the frozen request start
ts_event is less than or equal to ts_recv

source_tests.mbo: Snapshot structure must reproduce the previously sealed 2,744 rows, containing exactly 2,743 A rows and one R row.
source_tests.mbp10: Pre-start snapshot coverage must reproduce the previously sealed one row; its action must be A or R.

finding_rules.CONFIRMED: At least one BAD_TS_RECV row exists and every such row passes every frozen per-row and source test.
finding_rules.NOT_CONFIRMED: One or more BAD_TS_RECV rows is non-snapshot or violates receive-time, event-time, or action semantics, or sealed snapshot coverage is not reproduced.
finding_rules.UNRESOLVED: A source, schema, completeness, or reproduction failure prevents exact classification.

crossed_book_diagnostic.scope: Every authoritative MBP-10 row classified CONTINUOUS_MATCHING with defined positive level-00 sizes and counts on both sides and best ask strictly below best bid.
crossed_book_diagnostic.two_sided_definition: Level-00 bid and ask prices are not undefined and both level-00 size and count values are positive.
crossed_book_diagnostic.crossed_definition: Two-sided and ask_px_00 is strictly less than bid_px_00.
crossed_book_diagnostic.uncrossed_definition: Two-sided and ask_px_00 is greater than or equal to bid_px_00.
crossed_book_diagnostic.group_order: source_row_ordinal ascending; groups must be contiguous in the normalized source.
crossed_book_diagnostic.completed_boundary: The unique row in the native-event group with flags bit 128 set, and it must be the final source-order row of that group.
tests_per_crossed_row: number of F_LAST rows in the group
whether the unique terminal F_LAST row occurs after the crossed row
terminal F_LAST state classification as TWO_SIDED_UNCROSSED, CROSSED, or ONE_SIDED
receive-time delay to the terminal F_LAST row
whether completion occurs in the same one-second bucket
number of Step-4A bucket closes for which the crossed row remains the latest authoritative state before the next MBP-10 row or segment end
crossed_book_diagnostic.persistence_formula: Let t be crossed-row ts_recv and u be min(next MBP-10 row ts_recv, current market-segment end). Count one-second bucket ends e satisfying t < e <= u; never inspect or use a future price value in this calculation.

finding_rules.CONFIRMED: The sealed count of exactly one continuous crossed row is reproduced; every crossed row is non-snapshot, is not F_LAST, belongs to a contiguous group with one terminal F_LAST row after it, and that terminal state is TWO_SIDED_UNCROSSED; zero continuous terminal F_LAST rows are crossed.
finding_rules.NOT_CONFIRMED: A crossed row is snapshot, is terminal F_LAST, lacks a unique later terminal F_LAST, completes crossed or one-sided, or any continuous terminal F_LAST row is crossed.
finding_rules.UNRESOLVED: A source, schema, grouping, completeness, or reproduction failure prevents exact classification.

permitted: timestamp relation classes and elapsed nanoseconds
prohibited: spreads, midpoints, microprices, imbalances, or other feature values
technical_output_policy.row_identity_hash: SHA-256 of source name, source_row_ordinal, publisher_id, instrument_id, sequence, ts_event, and ts_recv in canonical big-endian form.

independent_reproduction.primary: Sequential fixed-state scan with contiguous native-event-group finalization and pending-next-row persistence resolution.
independent_reproduction.reference: Independent dictionary and occurrence-index scan with separately coded row tests, group classification, and persistence calculation.
independent_reproduction.complete_source_passes: Each implementation independently reads every MBO and MBP-10 row.
identical_required: source record counts and complete-pass checksums
continuous crossed-row count and exclusive taxonomy

both_findings_confirmed.bounded_text: In a future separately authorized amendment only, permit BAD_TS_RECV rows solely when they satisfy the frozen snapshot semantics, and construct authoritative MBP state only from the valid snapshot baseline or unique terminal F_LAST native-event boundaries. Keep every other Step 4A definition and gate unchanged.

diagnostic_status_rules.FAIL_PREDECESSOR_OR_SOURCE_INTEGRITY: A Step 4A artifact, source, schema, record count, or required quality seal differs.
diagnostic_status_rules.FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC_INTEGRITY: A complete-pass, ordering, grouping, classification-exhaustiveness, scope, value-reporting, or prohibited-work gate fails.
diagnostic_status_rules.FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC_REPRODUCTION: The two independent diagnostics differ on any frozen required output.
diagnostic_status_rules.PASS_DIAGNOSTIC_REPRODUCTION: Every diagnostic integrity and independent-reproduction gate passes; hypothesis findings may honestly be CONFIRMED, NOT_CONFIRMED, or UNRESOLVED.

prohibited: modifying Step 4A or any predecessor artifact or verdict
altering or rerunning the Step 4A feature pipeline
repairing, filtering, dropping, or relabeling source rows
using book values to choose a group, boundary, or alternate completion
aligning MBO rows to MBP-10 rows
testing targets, signals, candidates, relationships, or outcomes
trades, PnL, R multiples, or account returns
completion_policy: Record both findings and at most one recommendation, independently reproduce them, document and seal Step 4A.1, and stop without correction or research.
